title: A Archive for the Orbit
author: Orsen Crane
blurb: Gideon Underhill, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
